posts.text:
Enzo 💬 (On player fitness) The only one is [Ryan] McAidoo. In pre-season he had a small problem but he has worked with us.

Everyone is fit. All of them are fit but some have only arrived back today.

Enzo 💬 Arsenal have shown in the last three, four, five years they are always there, a fantastic team, managed well.

They won the Premier League. They’ve shown how good they are at this moment. But we are City and we want to close the gap.
Enzo 💬 (On the Community Shield) When a trophy and a final is there, you always try to win the game. It’s a trophy. We are going to try our best to win the first trophy.

Manager’s Preview:

🆚 Arsenal
🏆 Community Shield
🎙️ Enzo Maresca
▶️ mancity.co/ARSMCIPreview
So good to be back with you 🩵🏡
